This notebook re-creates, on the Pattern Data Commons copy of the PRINCE trial,
the kinds of analyses in Padron et al., *Nat Med* 2022 (PRINCE: sotigalimab
and/or nivolumab with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel in first-line metastatic
pancreatic cancer): overall survival, circulating immune populations over
treatment, survival stratified at the median of a baseline biomarker, marker
expression on those populations, serum proteins, and tumor gene expression
signatures.

It is a demonstration of the `patternq` workflow, not a re-analysis.

> **Treatment arm is not in the `prince-2022` database.** The paper stratifies
> most analyses by arm (nivo/chemo, sotiga/chemo, sotiga/nivo/chemo). Arm is in
> the source data (`PICI0002_ph2_clinical.csv`, `Arm` / `Actual Arm`) but was
> not imported, so here every analysis pools patients across arms and groups
> by survival status at 1 year. P-values are unadjusted and exploratory.

The same notebook exists in R (knitr), Clojure (Clay) and Julia in
`prince_demo.qmd` in [patternq-r](https://github.com/RCRF/patternq-r), `prince_demo.clj` in [patternq-clj](https://github.com/RCRF/patternq-clj) and
`prince_demo.qmd` in [PatternQ.jl](https://github.com/RCRF/PatternQ.jl).

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
import marimo as mo
import pandas as pd
import patternq as pq
import patternq.context as pqc
import patternq.dataset as pqd
import patternq.plots as pqp
import patternq.results as pqres
import patternq.survival as pqs
```

## The dataset

Every dataset is its own database. `resolve_db` maps the stable dataset name
to the current database.

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
db = pq.resolve_db("prince-2022")
pq.set_db(db)
mo.vstack([mo.md(f"`{db}`"), pqd.dataset_summary()])
```

Which subjects were profiled by which assays:

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
pqp.plot_sample_overview(pqd.sample_assays())
```

Samples by timepoint and specimen (blood draws at C1D1, C1D15, C2D1, C4D1;
tumor biopsies at screening):

```python {.marimo}

_smp = pqd.samples()
pd.crosstab(_smp["timepoint_id"], _smp["sample_specimen"])
```

## Outcomes

Best overall response, progression-free and overall survival (months) per
subject, and survival status at 1 year (the paper's primary endpoint is 1-year
OS). Subjects censored before 1 year have unknown status.

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
outcomes = pqd.subject_outcomes()
outcomes["status_1y"] = pqs.survival_status(outcomes, "os", "os_event", at=12)
status_levels = ["alive at 1 year", "died within 1 year"]
mo.hstack([outcomes["status_1y"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename_axis("status_1y").reset_index(),
           outcomes["bor"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename_axis("bor").reset_index()],
          justify="start")
```

Overall survival (Fig. 2a pools arms here) and by best overall response:

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
mo.vstack([
    pqp.plot_survival(outcomes, "os", "os_event", title="Overall survival", xlab="months"),
    pqp.plot_survival(outcomes, "os", "os_event", group="bor",
                      title="Overall survival by best overall response", xlab="months"),
])
```

Progression-free survival (Extended Data Fig. 2a):

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
pqp.plot_survival(outcomes, "pfs", "pfs_event", title="Progression-free survival", xlab="months")
```

## Circulating immune populations

Frequencies of gated populations from the X50 (flow) and CyTOF panels, with
sample context (subject, timepoint) and 1-year survival status joined on.

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
def with_status(tab):
    tab = pqc.add_sample_context(tab, include_subjects=False)
    return pqres.keep_provenance(tab.merge(outcomes[["subject_id", "status_1y"]], on="subject_id"), tab)

x50 = with_status(pqd.measurements("percent-of-parent", "PICI X50 Immune Profiling"))
cytof = with_status(pd.concat([
    pqd.measurements("percent-of-parent", "PICI CyTOF Immune Profiling"),
    pqd.measurements("percent-of-leukocytes", "PICI CyTOF Immune Profiling")], ignore_index=True))
blood_timepoints = ["C1D1", "C1D15", "C2D1", "C4D1"]
sorted(x50["cell_population"].unique())
```

Baseline (C1D1) value per subject for one population:

```{marimo .python name="baseline"}
def baseline(tab, population, timepoint="C1D1"):
    b = tab[(tab["cell_population"] == population) & (tab["timepoint_id"] == timepoint)]
    return b.groupby("subject_id")["value"].mean()
```

### CD38+ effector memory CD8 T cells (Fig. 3a, c)

OS stratified by the pre-treatment frequency, above vs below the median:

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
cd38_pop = "CD38+ effector memory CD8+ T cells (% effector memory CD8 T cells)"
_km = pqs.survival_by_median(baseline(x50, cd38_pop), outcomes)
mo.vstack([mo.md(f"log-rank p = {_km.attrs['logrank']['p']:.3g}"),
           pqp.plot_survival(_km, group="group", levels=["low", "high"], xlab="months",
                             title="OS by baseline CD38+ EM CD8 T cells (median split)")])
```

Frequencies before and on treatment, grouped by 1-year survival, with each
patient's trajectory:

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
pqp.plot_by_timepoint(x50[x50["cell_population"] == cd38_pop], group="status_1y", lines=True,
                      timepoints=blood_timepoints, levels=status_levels,
                      title="CD38+ EM CD8 T cells over treatment", ylab="% of EM CD8 T cells")
```

### PD-1+CD39+ EM1 CD4 T cells (Fig. 3d) and PD-1+Tbet+ non-naive CD4 T cells (Fig. 4f, h)

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_pops = ["PD-1+CD39+ effector memory 1 CD4+ T cells (% of effector memory 1 CD4 T cells)",
         "PD-1+Tbet+ non-Naive CD4+ T cells (% of CD4 not naive T cells)"]
_plots = []
for _pop in _pops:
    _km = pqs.survival_by_median(baseline(x50, _pop), outcomes)
    _plots.append(pqp.plot_survival(_km, group="group", levels=["low", "high"], xlab="months",
                                    title="OS by baseline " + _pop.split(" (")[0]))
mo.vstack(_plots)
```

### Cross-presenting dendritic cells (Fig. 4b)

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_km = pqs.survival_by_median(baseline(cytof, "CD1C+ CD141+ DC (% of leukocytes)"), outcomes)
pqp.plot_survival(_km, group="group", levels=["low", "high"], xlab="months",
```

### Proliferating T cells over treatment (Extended Data Fig. 3a)

Change relative to C1D1 (log2 fold change of the frequency):

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_ki67 = pqs.change_from_baseline(x50[x50["cell_population"] == "Ki67+ Non-Naive CD8 T Cells"],
                                 baseline="C1D1", method="log2_ratio", pseudocount=0.001)
pqp.plot_by_timepoint(_ki67, value="change", group="status_1y", lines=True,
                      timepoints=blood_timepoints, levels=status_levels,
                      title="Ki-67+ non-naive CD8 T cells, change from C1D1",
                      ylab="log2 fold change vs C1D1")
```

### Screening all baseline populations

Every X50 and CyTOF population at C1D1, median split, log-rank p (the paper's
Fig. 5 summarizes such associations per arm):

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
def screen(tab, panel):
    rows = []
    for pop in tab["cell_population"].unique():
        km = pqs.survival_by_median(baseline(tab, pop), outcomes)
        lr = km.attrs["logrank"]
        if not lr.get("observed"):
            continue  # no baseline values for this population
        hr = {g: lr["observed"][g] / lr["expected"][g] for g in lr["observed"]}
        rows.append({"panel": panel, "cell_population": pop, "n": len(km), "p": lr["p"],
                     "higher_is": "longer survival" if hr.get("high", 1) < hr.get("low", 1)
                     else "shorter survival"})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

assoc = pd.concat([screen(x50, "X50"), screen(cytof, "CyTOF")], ignore_index=True)
assoc = assoc.sort_values("p").reset_index(drop=True)
mo.ui.table(assoc.head(12).round({"p": 3}), page_size=12, selection=None)
```

## Marker expression on populations (Extended Data Figs. 7b, 8b)

Median channel values of markers on CD38+ non-naive CD8 T cells, pre-treatment,
per patient, z-scored per marker, patients annotated by 1-year survival:

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_mcv = with_status(pqd.measurements("median-channel-value", "PICI X50 Immune Profiling"))
_cd8 = _mcv[(_mcv["cell_population"] == "CD38+ non-naive CD8+ T cells (% non-naive CD8 T cells)")
            & (_mcv["timepoint_id"] == "C1D1")]
status = dict(zip(outcomes["subject_id"], outcomes["status_1y"]))
pqp.plot_heatmap(pqc.to_matrix(_cd8, row="epitope_id", col="subject_id"), scale="row", col_groups=status,
                 title="Markers on CD38+ non-naive CD8 T cells (C1D1, z-scored MFI)")
```

CCR7+ CD11b+ CD27- B cells (CyTOF) on treatment (C1D15):

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_mcv_b = with_status(pqd.measurements("median-channel-value", "PICI CyTOF Immune Profiling"))
_b = _mcv_b[_mcv_b["timepoint_id"] == "C1D15"]
pqp.plot_heatmap(pqc.to_matrix(_b, row="epitope_id", col="subject_id"), scale="row", col_groups=status,
                 title="Markers on CCR7+ CD11b+ CD27- B cells (C1D15, z-scored MFI)")
```

## Serum proteins (Extended Data Fig. 3c–f)

Olink NPX is on a log2 scale, so change from C1D1 is a difference:

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_olink = with_status(pqd.measurements("olink-npx", "PICI Olink Proteomics"))
_change = pqs.change_from_baseline(_olink, baseline="C1D1", method="difference")
_proteins = {"IFNG": "IFNG", "PD-1": "PDCD1", "CXCL9": "CXCL9", "CXCL10": "CXL10"}  # label: Olink id
mo.vstack([pqp.plot_by_timepoint(_change[_change["epitope_id"] == _id], value="change", group="status_1y",
                                 timepoints=blood_timepoints, levels=status_levels,
                                 title=f"{_label} change from C1D1", ylab="log2 NPX change")
           for _label, _id in _proteins.items()])
```

## Tumor: gene expression signatures and multiplex IF

Pre-treatment tumor RNA-seq signature scores, clustered, patients annotated by
1-year survival (Extended Data Figs. 4a, 6a). The RNA-seq data comes from the
cBioPortal / iAtlas release, which labels the pre-treatment timepoint `0`
(the PICI modalities use `screening` / `C1D1`):

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_sig = with_status(pqd.measurements("nanostring-signature-score", "cBioPortal Gene Expression Signatures"))
sig_pre = _sig[_sig["timepoint_id"].astype(str).isin(["screening", "0"])]
pqp.plot_heatmap(pqc.to_matrix(sig_pre, row="signature", col="subject_id"), scale="row", col_groups=status,
                 title="Tumor gene expression signatures (pre-treatment, z-scored)")
```

OS by the Th1 signature (Extended Data Fig. 6b):

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_th1 = sig_pre[sig_pre["signature"] == "Bindea_Th1_Cells"]
_km = pqs.survival_by_median(_th1.groupby("subject_id")["value"].mean(), outcomes)
pqp.plot_survival(_km, group="group", levels=["low", "high"], xlab="months",
                  title="OS by tumor Th1 signature (median split)")
```

OS by intratumoral iNOS+ macrophages from multiplex IF (Extended Data Fig. 4c):

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: true
_vectra = with_status(pqd.measurements("percent-of-total-cells", "PICI Vectra Multiplex IF"))
_inos = _vectra[(_vectra["cell_population"] == "iNOS+ macrophages (% of total cells)")
                & (_vectra["timepoint_id"] == "screening")]
_km = pqs.survival_by_median(_inos.groupby("subject_id")["value"].mean(), outcomes)
pqp.plot_survival(_km, group="group", levels=["low", "high"], xlab="months",
                  title="OS by tumor iNOS+ macrophages (median split)")
```
